Two protocols serve MemoService.

- gRPC-Gateway (HTTP/JSON REST): registered in `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/v1.go` at line 108 via `v1pb.RegisterMemoServiceHandlerServer`. Routes mount at lines 128-129 under `/api/v1/*`.
- Connect RPC: registered in `/bench/repo/proto/gen/api/v1/memo_service.pb.gw.go` at line 961 via `RegisterMemoServiceHandlerServer`.

Connect RPC registration occurs in `/bench/repo/server/router/aect_handler.go` at line 40 via `wrap(apiv1connect.NewMemoServiceHandler(...))`. This is called from `v1.go` lines 140-144 inside `RegisterConnectHandlers`, which mounts routes under `/memos.api.v1.*`. The connect adapter methods that wrap `APIV1Service` calls live in `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go` starting at line 304.

The generated Connect handler builder is located in `/bench/repo/proto/gen/api/v1/apiv1connect/memo_service.connect.go` at line 461 via `NewMemoServiceHandler`. No native gRPC server registration exists in application code; only the two HTTP-based protocols are used. Comments in `v1.go` confirm this: line 64 describes gateway registration, and line 131 notes Connect handlers replace grpc-web for browser clients.
